original_sentence: From May, Penny will be shipped on a subscription basis that offers "an immediate return", says Bear Robotics' chief operating officer, Juan Higueros.
translation: Bear Robotics 首席运营官 Juan Higueros 表示，从 5 月起，Penny 将以订阅模式发货，这种模式能带来“即时回报”。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: on a subscription basis 在本句中对应"以订阅模式"。
chief operating officer 在本句中对应"首席运营官"。
immediate return 在本句中对应"即时回报"。
be shipped 在本句中对应"被发货；被交付"。
